context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend refactoring regression test completed successfully. The monolithic server.py (3691 lines) was split into 8 modular router files: auth.py, exclusions.py, chat.py, recipes.py, meal_planning.py, diabetes.py, import_recipe.py, voice.py. All API endpoints function identically. Key findings: 1) All routers use /api prefix, 2) Protected endpoints require Bearer token, 3) Phone OTP works in demo mode, 4) SaveRecipeRequest expects nested 'recipe' object with RecipeCreate fields, 5) ShoppingListCreate expects 'items' array with dict items, 6) Voice languages returns dict with language names as keys (e.g., 'english' not 'en'). Test file: test_refactored_api.py
